get.description: Returns aggregate user and DSA-problem metrics. Active users use the latest reliable timestamp across activity events, practice attempts, and revision history.
Search, filter, sort, and paginate users without per-user queries.
Returns authoritative attempt, completion, topic, difficulty, and revision aggregates.
Composes reliable signup and problem-attempt events; newest activity is first.
Metrics use unique user/problem pairs; first-attempt success uses the earliest attempt.
Includes at most 20 recent attempts and never includes submitted source code.
Returns sanitized access records; credentials and authorization headers are never stored.
